verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an MFA/authenticator product, since its backup and push-approval back ends could be run on your own infrastructure. The evidence pack documents no self-hosted deployment option. Backups go to a Microsoft personal account or iCloud, and push sign-in approvals run through Microsoft's account and Entra services, so the axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
